look_here_first: Examine head side profile: oblong flower heads around 3.5–4.5 mm long, 2–3 times taller than wide, with visible capitular leaves emerging between heads. Compare with Diaperia verna, which has shorter, rounder heads.

morphology_keys.habit: Low annual with commonly dichasiform or pseudo-polytomous branch architecture.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Capitular leaves visibly project from between heads, unlike many D. verna heads.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Elongate cylindrical to ellipsoid heads approximately 3.5–4.5 mm tall, generally two to three times as high as wide.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Pistillate paleae around 2.5–4 mm, mature cypselae around 0.9–1.2 mm; mature microscopic evidence preferred.

comparisons.key_distinctions: D. verna commonly has rounded 2–3.3 mm heads and inconspicuous capitular leaves. Wool and absolute head counts overlap.

diagnostic_image_needs: needs_photo: side-on mature head with mm scale
